dedupe_keys.name: residential electricity load profiles in switzerland 2023 2024 eth zurich and ekz

description: This dataset holds 15-minute smart meter measurements from 2,447 residential installations in Switzerland for 2023 and 2024, published by ETH Zurich researchers with the Zurich cantonal utility EKZ. It includes active and reactive energy, both withdrawal and injection, for different installation types: apartments, single-family houses, heat pumps and common building areas. A subset of customers took part in a pilot with novel grid tariffs and automated load control, and the corresponding price profiles and metadata are included. The authors built it to support distribution grid modelling, load forecasting and the assessment of time-varying tariffs, noting that residential profiles are changing with rooftop generation, heat pumps and electric vehicles. Coverage: 2,447 installations in Switzerland; one author is affiliated with EKZ, and the preprint gives the supply area. Access: one ZIP of about 904 MB on Zenodo, version 1 of 21 July 2026, with a code repository. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the data descriptor was under peer review when read, and the field-level description is in the preprint, not the Zenodo record. Simulation uses: low-voltage network studies, heat pump and PV load modelling and demand response under dynamic tariffs. Related records: the CKW open smart meter data and the UK Energy Demand Research Project trials.
